scope: Internal request management (annual leave, unpaid leave, late arrival/early leave, overtime, business trip, remote work, missed attendance record)
User, department, role and system configuration

actors.name: Employee
actors.title: Employee
actors.description: Submits requests, tracks status, views remaining leave balance, cancels requests that are not yet approved. ~250 users across 3 branches (Hanoi, Da Nang, HCMC).

actors.name: Line Manager
actors.title: Line Manager
actors.description: Approves or rejects requests from their direct team; views the team leave calendar.

actors.name: HR Officer
actors.title: HR Officer
actors.description: Views all requests, configures request types and leave policy, adjusts leave balances, exports reports. Primary business owner of the system.

actors.name: Executive (Board of Directors)
actors.title: Executive (Board of Directors)
actors.description: Final approver for selected request types (e.g. overseas business trips); views consolidated reports.

actors.name: System Administrator
actors.title: System Administrator
actors.description: Manages users, departments, the management hierarchy, role permissions and system configuration.

useCases.title: Submit a request
useCases.description: Employee selects a request type (annual leave, unpaid leave, late arrival/early leave, overtime, business trip, remote work, missed attendance record), fills the type-specific form, optionally attaches a file, and submits.

useCases.title: Track and cancel own requests
useCases.description: Employee views the list of submitted requests with status (Pending / Approved / Rejected / Cancelled) and cancels a request while it is still unapproved.

useCases.title: Approve or reject a request
useCases.description: Approver reviews a pending request and approves it or rejects it with a mandatory reason; multi-level flows forward the request to the next approver.

useCases.title: Amend and resubmit a rejected request
useCases.description: Employee edits a rejected request and submits it again, restarting the approval flow.

useCases.title: Delegate approval authority
useCases.description: An approver who will be away delegates approval authority to another user (nice to have per RFP).

useCases.title: View leave balance
useCases.description: Employee views total / used / remaining annual leave days.

useCases.title: Adjust leave balance
useCases.description: HR manually adjusts an employee's leave quota (seniority bonus days, carried-over days from the previous year).

useCases.title: Receive notifications and reminders
useCases.description: Approvers are notified of new pending requests, employees are notified of approval or rejection, and approvers are reminded when a request is untouched for more than 24 hours.

useCases.title: View team leave calendar
useCases.description: Manager or team member views a department/team calendar showing who is on leave on which days.

useCases.title: Search and filter requests
useCases.description: Users search and filter requests by person, request type, date range and status.

useCases.title: View and export reports
useCases.description: HR and executives view leave statistics by employee, department and month, see employees running low on or under-using leave, and export reports to Excel.

useCases.title: Manage users, departments and permissions
useCases.description: Administrator manages user accounts, departments, the reporting hierarchy (who manages whom), and role-based permissions.

useCases.title: Configure request types and approval workflows
useCases.description: HR/Administrator defines request types and their multi-level approval routing through configuration, without code changes.

useCases.title: Configure public holidays
useCases.description: Administrator maintains the yearly public holiday calendar used when computing leave day counts.

useCases.title: Sign in with company email account
useCases.description: User authenticates using the company email account, ideally reusing the existing corporate identity.

features.title: Request submission and lifecycle management
features.description: Type-driven request forms, automatic leave-day computation excluding weekends and holidays, half-day handling, file attachments, status tracking, cancellation while pending, and overlap prevention.

features.title: Multi-level approval workflow
features.description: Configurable multi-level approval routing driven by request type and duration, approve/reject with mandatory rejection reason, resubmission after rejection, and approval delegation.

features.title: Annual leave balance management
features.description: Per-employee annual leave quota with automatic deduction on approval and restoration on cancellation or rejection, manual HR adjustment, and total/used/remaining display.

features.title: Notification and reminder service
features.description: In-app and email notifications for new pending requests and approval outcomes, plus reminders for requests pending longer than 24 hours; extensible to company chat tools.

features.title: Leave calendar and request lookup
features.description: Department/team leave calendar and search/filter over requests by person, type, date range and status.

features.title: Reporting and Excel export
features.description: Leave statistics by employee, department and month, low-balance and under-used-leave lists, and Excel export of all reports.

features.title: User, organization and access management
features.description: User, department and reporting-hierarchy management, role-based permissions, and authentication with the company email account.

features.title: Request type, workflow and holiday configuration
features.description: Configuration of request types, their form fields, approval routing rules and the yearly public holiday calendar without code changes.

functionalRequirements.title: Employee selects a request type and completes the form defined for that type
functionalRequirements.description: Each request type has its own set of fields.

functionalRequirements.title: Annual leave request captures start date, end date, half-day option (morning/afternoon) and reason
System automatically computes the number of leave days, excluding weekends and public holidays
Employee can attach files to a request
functionalRequirements.description: For example a medical certificate for sick leave.

functionalRequirements.title: Employee can view the list of submitted requests with status Pending / Approved / Rejected / Cancelled
Employee can cancel a request while it has not yet been approved
System rejects a leave request whose date range overlaps an existing request of the same employee
Approval routing has multiple levels determined by request type and number of days
Annual leave of 2 days or fewer requires only line manager approval; more than 2 days requires line manager then HR
functionalRequirements.description: Current company policy quoted in the RFP; must be configurable.

functionalRequirements.title: Overseas business trip requires line manager, then HR, then Executive approval
functionalRequirements.description: Current company policy quoted in the RFP; must be configurable.

functionalRequirements.title: Approver can approve or reject a request; a rejection reason is mandatory
Employee can amend a rejected request and resubmit it
An approver can delegate approval authority while away
functionalRequirements.description: Marked nice to have in the RFP.

functionalRequirements.title: Each employee has an annual leave quota, defaulting to 12 days and varying by seniority
Approving a leave request deducts leave days; cancelling or rejecting restores them
HR can manually adjust an employee's leave quota
functionalRequirements.description: For example seniority bonus days or days carried over from the previous year.

functionalRequirements.title: System displays total, used and remaining leave days
Approver is notified when a new request requires their action
Employee is notified when their request is approved or rejected
Approver is reminded when a request has been pending for more than 24 hours
Notifications are delivered in-app and by email, with company chat tools as a desired additional channel
System shows a department/team leave calendar indicating who is absent on which days
Users can search and filter requests by person, request type, date range and status
System reports leave days taken by employee, by department and by month
System lists employees close to exhausting their leave and employees with large unused balances
Reports can be exported to Excel
Administrator manages users, departments and the management hierarchy
HR/Administrator can configure request types and their approval flows without code changes
Administrator can configure the public holidays of the year
Access is granted by role
Users sign in with their company email account
functionalRequirements.description: Reusing the existing corporate account is preferred.

nfrs.title: User interface is in Vietnamese and simple enough for non-technical staff
System works well on mobile devices (responsive web at minimum)
Authentication uses the company email account, preferably the existing corporate identity provider
An employee can only view their own requests; permissions are enforced by role
System keeps an operation history recording who approved what and when
System runs stably during business hours for approximately 250 users
Cloud deployment is preferred; on-premise requires further discussion
Leave policy is configurable and can change year over year without code changes
System is extensible: new request types can be added and attendance-device integration is possible later
Target go-live is approximately 3 months, with phase 1 covering annual leave, approval and basic reporting

entities.name: Employee
entities.description: A staff member of the company, belonging to a department and reporting to a line manager.

entities.name: Department
entities.description: An organizational unit; used for the team leave calendar and departmental reporting.

entities.name: Request
entities.description: A submitted request of any type, with status Pending / Approved / Rejected / Cancelled.

entities.name: RequestType
entities.description: A configurable request category (annual leave, unpaid leave, late arrival/early leave, overtime, business trip, remote work, missed attendance) with its own form fields.

entities.name: ApprovalWorkflow
entities.description: Configured approval routing for a request type, including level order and conditions such as number of days.

entities.name: ApprovalStep
entities.description: One approval level of a request instance, recording approver, decision, reason and timestamp.

entities.name: Delegation
entities.description: Temporary transfer of approval authority from one approver to another during an absence.

entities.name: LeaveBalance
entities.description: An employee's annual leave quota for a year with total, used and remaining days.

entities.name: LeaveAdjustment
entities.description: A manual HR change to a leave balance, with reason and actor.

entities.name: Attachment
entities.description: A file attached to a request, such as a medical certificate.

entities.name: Holiday
entities.description: A public holiday date excluded from leave day computation.

entities.name: Notification
entities.description: An in-app or email message sent to an approver or requester, including 24-hour reminders.

entities.name: Role
entities.description: A permission set assigned to users (Employee, Line Manager, HR, Executive, Administrator).

entities.name: AuditLog
entities.description: Operation history record of who performed which action on which object and when.

constraints.description: Cloud infrastructure preferred; on-premise deployment requires further discussion.
The company already uses a corporate email system; single sign-on with existing accounts is desired.
Leave policy changes yearly and must be configurable rather than hard-coded.
Deliverables include a working responsive web system, user guides for employees and HR, training for HR and admins, and source code handover.
Desired go-live within about 3 months, phased delivery acceptable.

openQuestions.question: Which fields does each non-leave request type require (overtime, business trip, remote work, missed attendance)? Only the annual leave form is described.
What is the exact seniority rule that changes the annual leave quota from the 12-day default?
Do leave days carried over from the previous year expire, and if so when?
Which chat tool should notifications integrate with (Slack, Microsoft Teams, other)?
Which identity provider backs the company email account (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, other) and is SSO in scope for phase 1?
Is approval delegation (nice to have) in scope for phase 1?
How are pending requests handled when an employee changes department or leaves the company?
Does the interface need any language other than Vietnamese, given the project documentation language is English?
What are the data retention and backup frequency requirements?
Should historical paper/Excel request data be migrated into the new system?
